notes.title: Update to Version R.2.0 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Greetings, pilots

This update brings reworked gun gameplay, reworked cockpit visuals and several other updates and fixes. Details follow.

Guns are now easier and less frustrating to use. Instead of requiring reload after a set number of rounds, guns now overheat while firing and cool back down after a short duration. If you keep firing while the guns are overheated, you run the risk of jamming them, effectively rendering them useless for several precious seconds.

The game is now fully playable with mouse alone, if the middle button is assigned to "select enemy in front". The keyboard is still needed to scroll and sort the list of all contacts and to select the nearest enemy. The default keyboard&mouse configuration has been updated to this control layout.

Your ship's cockpit has received several improvements. Its position inside the ship has been tweaked to improve visibility. The tactical radar display has been removed. Its functionality has been merged into the navigation radar, whose surface has also increased by almost 50%.

Other, smaller improvements include tweaks to missile guidance and enemy fighters' AI, several other cockpit visual fixes and improvements and many more.

Looking forward to your thoughts on these changes
Fly safe and good hunting

notes.title: Situation Report - Mid August 2017
notes.content:
Briefly:
- "Assault" mission (first draft) is live
- next update (version EA.03: visual and gameplay improvements) is in progress
- price increase is delayed a few weeks


Greetings pilots and future pilots

Thanks for reading this report, and thank you very much indeed to everyone who purchased the game in its current, unfinished form.

I'll be describing in a bit more detail what's new in the game since the latest update and what'll be coming up next.

Version EA.02 has been live for about a week. The big addition was the first draft of the Assault mission, where you're tasked with clearing enemy turrets from a group of asteroids floating together in the middle of a nebula. This is the first version of this mission and it stands to receive significant updates.

Version EA.03 is currently in progress. It won't have big chunks of content, but I believe it will significantly improve what's currently in the game. Of course, you'll be the judge of that, but I'm feeling pretty optimistic. There will be some visual improvements and lots of gameplay tweaks and fixes, especially in the Assault mission. I'll go into more detail when the patch goes live.

The price increase that I've warned about in the previous announcement hasn't happened, for reasons beyond my control and that I wasn't aware of when I made that promise. So, for now the game is staying at its heavily reduced starting price; however, I am assured that the price boost will be able to take place sometime during September 2017.

That's all for now.
Thank you very much for your time
The dev
